day_boundary: Source time denotes UTC period start. Period end is exactly next UTC midnight; no timezone shift or nearest-day mapping. This is the original contract convention, not a newly proven universal cross-provider convention.
identity: Bind the whole ordered raw-page/receipt manifest, this contract and normalizer source into one snapshot ID; retain page and row provenance. This is a local immutable bundle, not proof of a vendor-atomic snapshot or historical publication.
numeric: Preserve positive native-ETH supply decimal strings exactly; no binary float, rounding, imputation or conversion to another supply metric.

clocks.constraints: If present: period_end <= clock <= retrieval. Missing remains null and makes the row ineligible; no clock substitution. Historical decision-time tests remain in the original closed contract, not rerun here.
clocks.interpretation: Computation clocks do not prove first publication and do not identify a value version.

admission.historical_vintage_unknown: Limitation, not an additional PIT prerequisite for this reconstructed-only mode.

reentry_evidence: Primary-source evidence binding the observed old/new supply difference to specific accounting definitions and revisions; an unsigned commit time or generic methodology page alone is insufficient.
One consistent whole-window methodology/version treatment across protocol changes, with exact receipts/hashes and no row-level provider splice.
Separate original capacity blocker 142<144 remains; explaining the eight revision rows alone neither restores the fifteen excluded weeks nor reopens the closed experiment.
